description: This walk visits the Healy Pass Waterfall on the Beara Peninsula in County Kerry. The old bridge and waterfall are located just to the east of Glanmore Lake. There's a small parking area where you can enjoy a view of the rushing waterfall and the beautiful lake below. You can then climb up the Healy Pass road for about 1km to the Glenmare Lake Viewpoint. There's another small parking area here if you would prefer to start the walk from here.While walking up the pass there are some truly spectacular views of the Caha Mountains.The climb toHungry Hillalso starts from the pass. There's some great views to the coast from here.
